transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus target function, adapting the inherent `[T]` receiver to an explicit `slice: &[T]` parameter and naming the return.
Attached the generated `slice_start_ptr(slice@, ptr)` postcondition to the target function; this records the contract under test and does not assume the target body.

Isolated the Rust body expression `self as *const [T] as *const T` in the target-local external function `rust_1_96_slice_as_ptr_cast`; Verus rejects the sibling mutable cast when placed directly in the non-external target body, so this mirrors that explicit source-backed raw-pointer/provenance boundary. The public target `as_ptr` is not external_body and calls only that boundary.
